note_en: 才 means "only then, not until": it signals that something happened later or with more effort than expected. 小张仔细看了很久，才发现… "Xiao Zhang watched closely for a long time before he noticed..." English needs "not until" or "only then," while Chinese simply puts 才 before the verb; compare 这才避免了一次损失 "that's the only reason a loss was avoided."
